name: LiquidGlassCard
description: Layered translucent card combining CSS backdrop blur, specular rim lighting, pointer-reactive highlight sheen, and optional SVG turbulence surface texture.
a11yNotes: Uses layered CSS translucency and SVG filter texture (without claiming physical optical refraction) while preserving high-contrast foreground text and fallback solid backgrounds when backdrop-filter is unsupported or prefers-reduced-motion is active.

defaultProps.title: Layered Specular Translucency
defaultProps.description: Combines CSS backdrop-filter blur, pointer-tracked rim illumination, and subtle surface sheen with graceful browser fallbacks.

propsApi.name: blurPx
propsApi.description: CSS backdrop-filter blur radius in pixels.

propsApi.name: rimIntensity
propsApi.description: Opacity of the pointer-reactive specular rim highlight.
